note: Chapter 6 from docs/chapter-06/CHAPTER_06_PRODUCTION.md. Human lines are overheard.

sb01_lights_not_yet.speaker: narrator
sb01_lights_not_yet.text: Just dark forest to the south.

C6_01_carnival.speaker: narrator
C6_01_carnival.text: Pasar Malam Impian. Coloured lights, a ferris wheel that turns the wrong way, and a ghost train whose cars have no wheels.

C6_01_carnival.speaker: narrator
C6_01_carnival.text: At the edges, the ordinary night market carries on: satay smoke, toy stalls, families. The humans walk right past the impossible rides without a glance.

C6_01_carnival.speaker: reno
C6_01_carnival.text: I am focusing. On the ghost train.

C6_01_carnival.speaker: elias
C6_01_carnival.text: The stub came from here. Somebody must have sold it to him.

C6_01_carnival.speaker: narrator
C6_01_carnival.text: In the middle of the midway, a paper lantern in a waistcoat is juggling fire for a crowd of spirits.

human_hawker.speaker: hawker
human_hawker.text: (calling) Satay! Satay! Ten sticks, best in the pasar malam!

human_family.speaker: family
human_family.text: (to her son) No, we're not going on the wheel again. It made you sick last time. ...Which wheel? THAT wheel. What do you mean, there isn't one?

carnival_stall.speaker: carnival_vendor
carnival_stall.text: Toffee apples! Sugarcane! Things that make you feel brave!

C6_02_taro_show.speaker: taro
C6_02_taro_show.text: Ladies, gentlespirits, and small leafy persons! The Great Taro!

C6_02_taro_show.speaker: lumi
C6_02_taro_show.text: We're looking for a man in a grey coat. Ink on his fingers. He had a ticket from here.

C6_02_taro_show.speaker: taro
C6_02_taro_show.text: Grey coat? Ink? Oh, absolutely, him. He's in the Hall of Mirrors. Right at the back. Can't miss him. Go on, go on!

C6_02_taro_show.speaker: narrator
C6_02_taro_show.text: New goal: search the Hall of Mirrors (the north-west tent).

taro_again.speaker: taro
taro_again.text: Hall of Mirrors! Back! Way, way back! Bye now!

pm01_train_closed.speaker: ticket_taker
pm01_train_closed.text: (from inside) Ghost Train is closed to the public. Performers only.

C6_03_mirrors.speaker: narrator
C6_03_mirrors.text: The Hall of Mirrors. A hundred Renos stare back at Reno. A hundred Renos make the same face.

C6_03_mirrors.speaker: lumi
C6_03_mirrors.text: There's an old echo marker by the door. If I look with Echo Sight, I might see which mirrors are really doorways.

mirror_echo_reno.speaker: reno
mirror_echo_reno.text: It just shows me my own face. Lumi?

C6_03_echo_sight.speaker: narrator
C6_03_echo_sight.text: Lumi looks with Echo Sight. Most of the mirrors are just mirrors. But three of them shimmer: old doorways, painted over with reflection.

C6_03_echo_sight.speaker: lumi
C6_03_echo_sight.text: There, there and there. We can walk through those.

pm02_doubles_beaten.speaker: reno
pm02_doubles_beaten.text: I beat myself up! ...That sounds bad.

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: narrator
C6_04_taro_caught.text: At the very back of the Hall of Mirrors there's no man in a grey coat. Just Taro, sitting on a crate, eating a toffee apple.

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: taro
C6_04_taro_caught.text: Oh. You actually got through. Nobody gets through.

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: taro
C6_04_taro_caught.text: I lie to everyone. It's my act. ...He asked me to. The grey-coat man. He said people would come asking, and I should send them the wrong way.

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: maris
C6_04_taro_caught.text: Why would you do that for him?

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: taro
C6_04_taro_caught.text: Because he looked so sad. And I thought, what's the harm, it's only a little lie. But Ringmaster's been hiding his trail ever since, and the whole carnival feels... wrong. Like a trick nobody's enjoying.

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: taro
C6_04_taro_caught.text: ...Fine. Yes. The Great Taro, honest for one whole night. Don't tell anyone.

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: narrator
C6_04_taro_caught.text: Taro joined the party! In battle: Trick Shot and Dazzle (hits every enemy). In the field: Decoy.

C6_04_taro_caught.speaker: taro
C6_04_taro_caught.text: The Ringmaster's in the Big Top. Only way in is the Ghost Train. Performers' entrance. Come on.

ticket_taker.speaker: ticket_taker
ticket_taker.text: Performers only. Tickets, tickets. No funny business near my lever.

C6_05_decoy_offer.speaker: taro
C6_05_decoy_offer.text: Ticket-taker never takes his eyes off that lever for long. I could make a Decoy and walk him off. Or you could be quick.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: Taro claps. A second, slightly wobblier Taro bows, waves, and strolls off down the platform. The ticket-taker follows it, shouting "Oi! Tickets!"

then.speaker: taro
then.text: Wait until he looks away. Then go!

C6_05_lever.speaker: narrator
C6_05_lever.text: Clunk. The ride lever goes over. Down the track, a train with no wheels glides up to the platform.

lever_done.speaker: narrator
lever_done.text: The lever is down. The Ghost Train is waiting.

C6_06_ride.speaker: narrator
C6_06_ride.text: The Ghost Train waits, lanterns swinging.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The Ghost Train plunges into the dark. Skeleton puppets, howling paper ghosts, a cardboard moon.

C6_06_bigtop.speaker: narrator
C6_06_bigtop.text: The Big Top. Empty seats in rings, and one spotlight on a tall spirit in a red coat and a top hat.

C6_07_ring_intro.speaker: ringmaster
C6_07_ring_intro.text: Welcome, welcome! Is there a grey-coat man here? Maybe! Did he come through? Maybe! Will you find him? MAYBE!

C6_07_ring_intro.speaker: taro
C6_07_ring_intro.text: Boss. They're friends. Just tell them.

C6_07_ring_intro.speaker: ringmaster
C6_07_ring_intro.text: Taro, my star! You'll understand after the show. The show must go on!

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: narrator
C6_07_ring_outro.text: The Ringmaster's hat falls off. Without it he's quite short, and very tired.

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: ringmaster
C6_07_ring_outro.text: ...All right. All right. He came here because the carnival is where people come to forget for a night. He wanted it to be forever.

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: ringmaster
C6_07_ring_outro.text: I hid his trail because I felt sorry for him. He bought a one-way ticket. East, over the sea, to the mountain where the Oathkeepers swore their oath.

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: narrator
C6_07_ring_outro.text: Got the One-Way Ticket Stub and the Juggler's Ribbon (Taro: SPD +3, ATK +2).

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: lumi
C6_07_ring_outro.text: The Oathkeepers. The crying spirit in the memory wore their coat.

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: taro
C6_07_ring_outro.text: Then that's where we're going. Boss, I'm taking a holiday.

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: ringmaster
C6_07_ring_outro.text: (putting his hat back on) Maybe you'll come back. ...Maybe!

C6_07_ring_outro.speaker: reno
C6_07_ring_outro.text: A ship over the sea! Do they have... boats? I like boats now.
